statement: A business must disclose and deliver the information required by a verifiable consumer request free of charge within 45 days of receiving the request; the period may be extended once by an additional 45 days when reasonably necessary, provided the consumer is given notice of the extension within the first 45-day period (Civ. Code § 1798.130(a)(2)(A)).
caveat: The default disclosure covers the 12-month period preceding receipt of the request (§ 1798.130(a)(2)(B)), identity verification and delivery mechanics are refined by the CPPA's regulations, and deletion, correction, and opt-out requests carry their own mechanics elsewhere in § 1798.130 and the regulations. Statutory text verified on the FindLaw mirror; confirm against leginfo.legislature.ca.gov before relying. This repo does not calculate or extend the deadline.
